html:
When you or a loved one is dealing with severe knee pain from advanced arthritis, simple everyday activities like walking or climbing stairs can feel like a mountain to climb. Traditional surgery has helped millions, but many patients worry about the pain of recovery and how natural the new joint will actually feel. If you are looking for a permanent solution to joint pain, understanding modern surgical upgrades is essential. Choosing an advanced total knee replacement hospital in Ahmedabad allows you to access revolutionary tools like the VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution, which completely changes how knee surgeries are performed.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we want our patients to understand that this technology does not replace the surgeon. Instead, the robotic system acts as a highly precise digital guide that helps our orthopedic team plan and execute your surgery with sub-millimeter accuracy, tailoring the implant perfectly to your unique body.

The benefits of VELYS robotic knee replacement are:

  • No Need for Pre-Operative CT Scans

With older robotic systems, patients are usually forced to undergo expensive pre-operative CT scans to create a 3D model of their joint. The advanced VELYS system uses completely “imageless” technology. When you are in the operating theatre, our team registers your unique anatomy digitally in real-time. This entirely eliminates the need for extra diagnostic imaging, saving you from unnecessary radiation exposure and lowering your overall pre-surgical costs.

  • Unmatched Precision for a Natural Feel

The biggest benefit of a robotic-assisted procedure is how balanced the knee feels afterward. The system utilises high-speed infrared cameras and optical trackers that monitor your leg’s micro-movements instantly during bone preparation. This allows our surgeons to remove only the precise, damaged portions of the bone while completely shielding the surrounding healthy soft tissues and ligaments. Because the implant aligns perfectly with your natural anatomy, your new knee flexes and bends much more naturally.

  • Drastically Reduced Pain and Quicker Recovery

Because the robotic arm executes cuts cleanly without needing bulky manual cutting blocks, there is significantly less trauma to the knee joint. This structural preservation means lower post-operative pain and less swelling. Most of our patients are back on their feet and walking within 24 hours of surgery.

If you are looking to reclaim your mobility, choosing the right total knee replacement hospital in Ahmedabad ensures you receive top-tier care. Visit us at our Satellite or Nirnay Nagar branches to speak with our specialists today.
